name: Campfire
positioning: Leadership development that fits inside real work — flexible to fit your brand, your frameworks, and your culture.

logos.use: Place on #1C1334 or #262F56. Use for all dark video scenes.

logoRules.clearspace: Minimum clearspace on all sides = height of the flame mark.
never: Do not add shadow, glow, or outline
Do not place over busy photography or the topo pattern without a solid scrim
Do not stretch, rotate, or rebuild the lockup

colors.name: Hot Pink
colors.role: Loud CTA only — one per scene

colors.name: Midnight
colors.role: Primary dark background — default video scene background

colors.name: White
colors.role: Page background; all text on dark

fonts.notes: Public equivalent of the licensed Spartan MB cut. Use this name in Arcade.

fonts.role: Licensed production cut of the same design
Occasional editorial accent only — never body or UI

radii.note: Pill only for chips and circular avatars.

backgrounds.role: Signature topographic texture over purple — hero and CTA surfaces
Tall crop of the same, for full-height scenes
Transparent topo overlay — layer over any dark or saturated fill

backgroundRules: Any dark or saturated surface gets a topo overlay. White lines on dark, dark lines on light.
Max one loud pink element per scene.

imagery.illustrationStyle: Single hand-drawn object. Warm earthy brown outline (~#876F4D), one or two flat fills in purple, pink, or warm yellow. Loose and sketched — deliberately not geometric. 80px in cards.
imagery.illustrationRule: FIXED SET. Do not generate new illustrations in this style. Use only these files; if none fits, use a Material Symbol or nothing.
imagery.photography: Warm-lit, natural, real people, often outdoor. Never cool/blue/clinical, never black-and-white, no saturated brand-colour overlays. Slight grain acceptable.
imagery.emoji: Never. Not in copy, not as ornament.

voice.register: Confident, warm, plain-spoken. Direct not loud. Confident not boastful — numbers do the bragging. Human not corporate.
voice.person: Second person for the reader ('your teams', 'your reality'). First-person plural for Campfire ('we handle the logistics'). Never 'I'. Avoid 'the leader' / 'the organization'.
voice.casing: Sentence case for headlines and card titles. UPPERCASE tracked 0.08–0.16em for buttons and eyebrows.
voice.punctuation: Spaced em-dashes ( — ) for cadence. Curly quotes. Contractions encouraged. No exclamation points. No emoji.
voice.headlineDevice: Two-tone: most of the line in #1E2A4A with one fragment in #6E3FCC. On dark, white with a #9D88ED fragment.

doNotUse.extendedPalette: The Matchbox extended palette (Ladybug, Carrot, Canary, Meadow, River, Rose, Dusk, and the earth tones Moss/Doe/Camel/Clay/Elk) exists for decks and charts ONLY. Never pull it into video or marketing surfaces.
doNotUse.coachRose: The coaching-tools rose palette (#BF4C74 family) belongs to tools.getcampfire.com, not to brand video.
